#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    
    int ans = 0;
    int n = s.length();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
        char current = s[i];
        int count = 0;
        int j = i;
        while (j < n && s[j] == current) {
            count++;
            j++;
        }
        if ((count & 1) == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
